pages.text: The $(item)Tape Player$() plays a $(item)tape reel$() out loud and into every radio touching it: the radio keys up and transmits the tape, then lets go when it ends.$(br2)Use a reel on the player to load it, an empty hand for the controls, and sneak with an empty hand (or EJECT) to take it out.

pages.title: Modes
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Manual$(): plays when you press PLAY.$(li)$(thing)Loop$(): again a second after it ends.$(li)$(thing)Interval$(): every 1 to 60 minutes (- and +, shift for tens).$(li)$(thing)Redstone$(): once for each redstone pulse.$(br)A beacon that calls every five minutes is one tape on Interval.

pages.title: Recording
pages.text: Press REC with a blank or recorded tape in, talk (everyone within six blocks is picked up), and STOP. A tape holds a minute, in telephone quality. Recording again wipes it. $(thing)Found$() tapes, with their own labels, cannot be recorded over.$(br2)Tapes and the tape player have no crafting recipe yet.
